messages:
Front Desk: Heads up — we have a visitor check-in: Alex from Melody Labs arriving in ~20 mins with a large crate and a ukulele case. Any preferred seating? Also needs a day badge.
Maya L: Thanks! Can you add them to the guest list as alex@melodylabs.com and give them a paper badge? I'll be at the 3rd-floor meeting room in 10.
Front Desk: Added to the list. Badge will be at desk 2.
ReceptionBot: Guest Alex (alex@melodylabs.com) checked in at 2026-03-23 14:12. Badge ID G-4821.
Samir: If it's a crate, can we put it in Storage B near the bike racks? Locker won't fit a crate.
Tara: We have two hotdesks free near the window if they'd like a quieter spot to tune.
Jin: Also FYI there's a delivery downstairs addressed to "Melody Labs" — says 'fragile instrument'. Is that the same?
Maya L: Yes, sounds like it. Front Desk, can you confirm the courier label and add a fragile sticker? Thanks :raised_hands:
Front Desk: Confirmed label matches Alex. I'll tag FRAGILE and move the crate to Storage B. The ukulele case fit in Locker A3 (tag attached). Locker A3 code `7777` — give to visitor on checkout.
Samir: Perfect. Can someone move the box off the couch? It's currently holding court :sweat_smile: 
Tara: I'll shuffle my plant and free up the couch. Alex asked for a power outlet — window desks have outlets, shall we reserve desk 4?
Maya L: Yep window desk 4 reserved, sticky note placed.
ReceptionBot: Note: Package tagged FRAGILE and stored in Storage B. Locker A3 assigned for instrument.
Jin: One more thing — badge printer is low on yellow visitor badges. Can people ops restock?
People Ops: On it — new shipment scheduled for tomorrow morning. :truck: 
Maya L: Awesome, thanks everyone for the quick help :heart:
